The full stereotype inheritance structure for the mapping relations extensions

The complete stereotype breakdown structure for mboeMappingRelation.

The other diagrams with names prefixed by 'mappingRelation -' in the same package as this diagram show smaller parts of this breakdown structure for improved readability. The other diagrams also provide complete, overlapping coverage of all the mappingRelation stereotypes.

For an overview of all mappingRelation diagrams, see Section 7 in the Model Guide - Read Me First
